docs: docs/snooze-marks.md § Conformance vectors. Display-only snooze marks: the definition alarm clock, the woken link pill, Snoozed row paint with heading summaries, and the bob-plan snooze chip. Each vector pins an explicit clock, source facts, task and resolver facts, and the expected display model. Later bob-ledger-tools phases copy this file byte-for-byte into their fixture directory and execute their group's inputs and expected values verbatim, with BOB_CLI_DIR pointing at this bob-cli checkout; no test substitutes simplified local data.

schemas.plan: input: {today, now, zone, note, today_count, links_count, cap, queue [{id, state 'asleep'|'due'|'blocked', on_clock, target}], excluded [{id, reason}], daily_missing bool, toggles {snooze_marks}}; expected: {chip bool, text|null, tone 'indigo'|'amber'|null, tooltip|null, forecast {count, cap, over}, lint null|'snooze_wake_would_exceed_cap'}
schemas.rows: paint input: {today, now, zone, note, note_date, row {line_text, kind 'active'|'history'|'ignored'|'fenced'|'indented', link_form 'plain'|'embedded'|'aliased'|'local', target}, task {status, resolution, is_task, is_event}, toggles {snooze_marks}}; paint expected: {paint 'asleep'|'due'|'blocked'|'history'|'ignored'|'historical'|'none', time_pill|null 'HH:MM', status_text|null, live_countdown bool}. summary input: {today, now, zone, note, rows [{id, target, state, on_clock}], toggles {snooze_marks}}; summary expected: {summary string|null}
schemas.woken: input: {today, now, zone, note, note_date, entry {open, name}, link {line, struck, is_event, is_prose, is_embed, in_fence, aliased, block}, history [{route, block, line, woke_at 'HH:MM', target 'HHMM'}], active_row_for_identity bool, resolution 'found'|'missing'|'ambiguous', target_status, toggles {snooze_marks}}; expected: {pill 'fresh'|'settled'|'quiet'|'none', text|null, tooltip|null (two lines joined by \n), navigates_to {note, line}|null}
